description: This file implements a custom guardrail for tool permission management within a language model interaction framework. It defines the ToolPermissionGuardrail class, including methods for checking tool permissions before and after model calls, modifying requests and responses to enforce permissions, and handling streaming responses. The code integrates with FastAPI, uses regex for rule matching, and references various internal modules related to guardrails, caching, logging, and model response handling.

classes.name: ToolPermissionGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class designed to enforce tool permission rules in models, managing both pre-call and post-call permission checks. It supports rule configuration, regex pattern matching for rule targeting, request and response modification to block unauthorized tool usage, and integrates with logging and guardrail management utilities.
